entries.1d6b8ec1b3569f57: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,769 million, up 14.0% from the previous year. Civil engineering-related revenue rose 35.1% from the previous year to ¥11,213 million, owing to an increase in work carried over from the previous year. Building construction-related revenue rose 7.0% to ¥25,125 million, owing to an increase in government office construction work and other factors. Side Business revenue fell 8.7% to ¥431 million, owing to a decline in asphalt mix shipments across Gunma Prefecture and intensified competition on order prices, among other factors.

entries.34d18c2ef5e3bf02: Under its basic philosophy, 'Challenge the Next Future with our Passion!', the company has formulated a 'Medium-Term Management Plan (2025.4-2028.3)'.
